name.value: The Seasider Bistro + Wine Bar + Patio

description.value: The Seasider Bistro is Powell River's self-described destination dining room, perched on the waterfront of the Beach Gardens Resort & Marina with an oceanfront patio overlooking the Malaspina Strait. The kitchen leans heavily on local West Coast seafood — Salt Spring Island mussels, BC king salmon, Hokkaido scallops — and pairs it with a dedicated wine bar and craft beer list featuring local producers. For a touring cyclist arriving in Powell River via the Sunshine Coast, this is a genuine splurge stop in a striking setting.
